name: bearing
description: A developer workflow for coding agents: skills for every stage from brief to runbook, review subagents, one guard behind every hook, and repository templates. The stack conventions come in bearing-backend and bearing-apps, and the GenAI and ML skills in bearing-genai.

tracker.title: Task tracker
tracker.description: none, jira, gitlab, github or rest. Empty: bearing.env, else none. The token stays in bearing.env.

tracker_url.title: Tracker URL
tracker_url.description: https:// base URL of the tracker, for example https://you.atlassian.net. Empty: bearing.env.

tracker_project.title: Tracker project
tracker_project.description: Jira project key, GitLab group/project or GitHub owner/repo. Empty: bearing.env.

tracker_email.title: Tracker account email
tracker_email.description: The email Jira signs the token with. Empty: bearing.env.

task_id_prefix.title: Task id prefix
task_id_prefix.description: Upper-case prefix of task ids, for example PROJ in PROJ-142. Empty: bearing.env, else any id.

learning.title: Local learnings
learning.description: on or off: learn from gate blocks and reruns, on this machine only. Empty: ask once.

noninteractive.title: Never ask questions
noninteractive.description: on for sessions nobody watches: hooks print no questions to ask the user. Empty: bearing.env, else off.

update_check.title: Check for Bearing updates
update_check.description: off stops the once-a-day check for a newer release at session start. Empty: bearing.env, else on.
